action: 先用自己的话写：我想每天记下学了什么，关闭网页、重启电脑后还能看到。跟练项目只给自己在本机使用。
Write your own goal: record what you learned and find it after closing the page and restarting. This practice is for personal local use.
expected: 你能说清“写一条、保存、再次找到”，而不是只说做一个漂亮网页。
You can describe writing, saving and finding a record.
recovery: 还没有想法时，把今天学的一件小事作为第一条测试内容，不把示例说成真实验收结果。
Use one thing learned today as test content, not as fabricated acceptance evidence.
instruction: 本项目：个人学习记录。使用者：我自己。第一版：输入标题和内容，保存到后端数据库，读取历史记录。暂不做登录、分享、编辑和删除。
Project: personal learning journal. User: myself. Version one: enter title and body, save in a backend database and read history. No login, sharing, editing or deletion yet.

action: 把前一步想法整理进模板；在“通过条件”写明：换一个浏览器打开同一服务仍能读到记录。
Fill the brief; include reading the record in a second browser connected to the same service.
expected: 项目描述明确有页面、后端和数据库；本机使用不等于只存在浏览器里。
The brief requires a page, backend and database; local use does not mean browser-only storage.
recovery: 若只写“刷新不丢”，补上重启服务和第二浏览器读取，避免把浏览器缓存误当数据库。
Add server restart and second-browser checks; refresh alone does not establish database storage.
instruction: 测试条件：合法输入保存成功；空白被拒绝；服务停止时不显示保存成功；重启后能读回；连点一次提交不产生重复记录。
Criteria: valid save, blank rejection, no false success while offline, restart persistence, and no duplicate from double clicking a single submission.

action: 在 Codex 中选择能关联本机文件夹的项目。先看下面定位图：项目、对话、文件预览分别做什么。
Choose a Codex project connected to a local folder. Use the location map to distinguish project, conversation and file preview.
expected: 能在项目对话让 Codex 检查文件并报告实际路径。
Codex can inspect files and report their actual location.
recovery: 找不到入口时查看官方项目说明；不要把普通问答会话当成已经连接项目。
Use official project instructions if controls differ; a chat alone does not prove project access.
instruction: 跟练工具填写 Codex；记录实际系统、登录和文件访问结果，费用按本人账号核对。
Record Codex, your actual OS, sign-in and file-access results; check costs in your own account.

action: 在文稿里新建 learning-journal 文件夹。它是练习项目，不是本网站的源码目录。
Create learning-journal in Documents. It is the practice project, not this guide repository.
expected: 知道完整位置，里面没有别人的项目。
You know the full location and it does not contain another project.
recovery: 已有同名目录先检查内容；不要清空它，必要时新建 learning-journal-practice。
Inspect an existing folder; do not empty it. Use learning-journal-practice if necessary.
instruction: 填入自己电脑上的实际路径，不照抄作者的用户名或路径。
Enter your own computer path rather than an author’s username or path.

action: 打开刚建的项目文件夹，在其中新建对话，发送只读路径检查。
Open the new folder, start its chat and send the read-only path check.
expected: 回复路径与自己建立的文件夹一致。
The returned location matches the folder you created.
recovery: 不一致先切换项目，不能通过让 AI 移动其他项目的文件来凑路径。
Switch projects if mismatched; do not move another project’s files to force a match.
instruction: 本次练习目录是本人填写的路径。只核对位置，暂不安装 Flask 或创建应用。
Use my supplied practice directory. Inspect location only; do not install Flask or create an app yet.

action: 把全栈练习的已确认描述交给 Codex，保存 idea.md 和起点版本。
Give Codex the confirmed full-stack brief; save idea.md and a baseline revision.
expected: idea.md 包含后端数据库保存要求，Git 版本可以指出。
idea.md includes backend database storage and a real revision is identified.
recovery: 提示 Git 身份未设置时，按 AI 提供的位置设置本人确认的提交身份；不要随便编造邮箱。
If Git identity is missing, configure your chosen identity in the described location; do not invent an email.
instruction: 项目规则补充：本机单人练习，不开放公网；数据库文件和虚拟环境不提交；不使用 localStorage 代替本项目数据库。
Rules: personal local practice, no public exposure; exclude database and virtual environment from Git; do not replace the database with localStorage.

action: 点击 Codex 回复中的 idea.md 文件链接，或在原项目文件夹打开它，核对正文。
Open the idea.md link in Codex or the file in your folder and read it.
expected: 能在文件正文找到“后端数据库”和本机使用范围。
The file states backend database storage and local use.
recovery: 只有聊天里一段文字不算文件；把找不到的文件名交给 Codex 只读检查。
Chat text is not a saved file; ask Codex to inspect the missing filename.
instruction: 请指出 idea.md 中有关前端、后端、数据库和第一版范围的原文位置。只读取，不补写不存在的内容。
Identify the actual passages about frontend, backend, database and version-one scope in idea.md. Read only; do not invent missing text.

action: 逐个回答：谁使用、是否公开、记录哪些字段、保存后如何找回。跟练先选本机单人。
Answer one question at a time: user, public access, fields and retrieval. Start with one local user.
expected: 已确定标题、内容、时间；明确不需要登录和跨设备联网。
Title, body and time are agreed; login and networked cross-device use are excluded.
recovery: 若要多人在线使用，先明确身份和资料隔离，回到范围确认，不能直接套用无登录练习。
For shared online use, define identity and isolation before scope; do not expose the login-free practice.
instruction: 只问影响本机学习记录第一版的未知项，尤其区分“第二浏览器测试”和“互联网多人共享”。
Clarify only unknowns affecting the local journal, distinguishing a second-browser check from Internet sharing.

action: 确认只做新增记录和历史列表；一条记录含标题、内容、创建时间。
Agree on creating records and listing history, with title, body and creation time.
expected: 列表、新增、保存失败提示和重新读取都有通过条件。
Create, list, failure feedback and retrieval have criteria.
recovery: 有人建议先加账户或云数据库时，要求说明是否为本机单人版必需。
If accounts or cloud storage are proposed, ask whether local single-user use requires them.
instruction: 将已确认示例范围编号：R1 页面输入和列表；R2 后端校验及 SQLite 保存读取；R3 异常提示、提交中防连点、重启持久化。
Number agreed scope: R1 input/list page; R2 backend validation and SQLite persistence; R3 error feedback, pending-submit protection and restart persistence.

action: 逐项核对标题 1–80 字、内容 1–2000 字；前后空格不算有效内容。保存成功后才清空输入。
Review title length 1–80 and body 1–2000 after trimming. Clear input only after a successful save.
expected: 服务不可用时原输入保留；后端独立拒绝空白和超长内容。
Unavailable service preserves input; backend independently rejects blank and oversized fields.
recovery: 若只写“按钮可点”，追问存错、断开和空白分别显示什么，不让学员猜。
If requirements merely say clickable, specify failed saves, offline behavior and blank input.
instruction: 补充已确认 R1–R3 的具体输入限制、提交中禁用按钮、失败保留输入、成功重新读取列表。只写需求，不开发。
Specify agreed R1–R3 input limits, disabled pending button, preserved failed input and refreshed successful list. Requirements only, no code.

action: 用一句完整场景串起来：晚上打开网页，写今天学到的事，保存，第二天再次打开查到。
Describe opening the journal, writing today’s learning, saving and finding it the next day.
expected: docs/stories.md 同时覆盖正常保存与保存失败后重试。
docs/stories.md covers successful saving and retry after failure.
recovery: 不要把“数据库插入成功”当用户操作；学员实际要点击和查看的是网页。
A database insert is not a user action; the learner clicks and reads the page.
instruction: 在 docs/stories.md 写新增、读回、空白拒绝和服务停止后重试场景，对应 R1–R3。
Write create, read, blank rejection and stopped-service retry stories in docs/stories.md, linked to R1–R3.

action: 只看输入框、保存按钮、状态提示和历史列表的位置；用明显标记的模拟记录试顺序。
Review input fields, Save, status and history using clearly labeled mock data.
expected: 能说出保存前、提交中、成功、失败四种画面；原型还没有真实数据库。
You recognize idle, saving, success and failure; the prototype has no real database yet.
recovery: 看起来能保存也先问是否模拟，不能把演示当后端完成。
Ask whether saving is mocked; a demonstration does not establish a working backend.
instruction: 读取 docs/stories.md；原型标注“模拟数据”。仅演示四种状态，交互决定写 docs/design.md，不实现真实保存。
Read docs/stories.md, label mock data and demonstrate four states only. Record interaction decisions in docs/design.md without real persistence.

action: 认识三部分：浏览器里的 HTML/CSS/JavaScript 是页面；Python Flask 接收请求；SQLite 把记录放在电脑文件里。
Identify the HTML/CSS/JavaScript page, Python Flask request handler and SQLite file storing records.
expected: docs/design.md 写出每部分做什么、文件放哪、如何一起启动。
docs/design.md explains roles, file locations and startup.
recovery: 已有项目使用另一套已确认技术时沿用，不能为了跟练重建；请 AI 给相同三层的对应位置。
Keep an existing confirmed stack; ask for equivalent three-layer locations instead of rebuilding.
instruction: 新练习建议 Flask 同时提供页面与 /api/entries，避免两个服务跨域；SQLite 固定 instance/journal.sqlite 路径，参数化查询。本机单人无登录，不适合直接公开。解释依赖和本机成本，待本人确认再保存设计，不安装。

For a new practice, propose Flask serving both page and /api/entries to avoid cross-origin setup, SQLite at a fixed instance/journal.sqlite path and parameterized queries. Local single-user, no login, unsuitable for direct public exposure. Explain dependencies/local costs and await design confirmation; do not install.

action: 任务表分成环境、页面、数据库建表、后端接口、页面接线、失败处理、重启和验收；一次执行一项。
Plan environment, page, database setup, backend API, connection, failures, restart and acceptance as separate tasks.
expected: 每项有文件、依赖和亲手检查方法，保存功能明确在哪一项完成。
Every task has files, dependencies and personal checks; persistence has an explicit task.
recovery: 任务只有“实现后端”时，要求拆成建表、写入读取、连接页面，避免一次做完无法核对。
Split a vague backend task into table setup, API and page connection so each can be checked.
instruction: 给任务标对应教学动作：preview 先做页面，interface 核对界面，save 完成数据库/接口/页面连接并逐项停下，flow 才做全流程。已完成任务只复核不重复实现。

Map tasks to lessons: preview builds the page, interface checks it, save implements database/API/page connection with pauses, then flow verifies end to end. Review completed tasks instead of rebuilding.

action: 在 Codex 项目对话发送环境提示词；让它检查 Python，再创建本项目 .venv（单独放依赖的文件夹）并安装确认过的 Flask。
Send the environment prompt in the project chat. Check Python, create a project .venv for dependencies and install the agreed Flask.
expected: 最小服务打开真实 http 地址；README 有所在目录、启动命令和停止方式。
A minimal service opens at a real HTTP address; README records directory, start and stop instructions.
recovery: 提示 command not found 就核对运行时，No module named flask 就核对是否用了 .venv；不要用管理员权限乱装。
For command not found check the runtime; for No module named flask check .venv. Avoid indiscriminate administrator installs.
instruction: 核对 Python 官方安装入口和实际版本。Mac/Linux 可用 python3 -m venv .venv，Windows 可用 py -3 -m venv .venv，先确认命令存在；用 .venv 的 Python 安装锁定依赖。启动最小 Flask 入口，不实现记录业务，报告真实端口和停止方式。

Check official Python installation and actual version. After verifying commands, use python3 -m venv .venv on Mac/Linux or py -3 -m venv .venv on Windows. Install pinned dependencies using that environment’s Python. Start a minimal Flask entry without journal logic; report actual port and stop method.

title: 网址打不开 / Connection refused
URL refuses connection
check: 先看 Codex 的服务输出是否还在运行，核对真实端口。
Check that this service is running and compare its actual port.
action: 请 Codex 只重启本项目服务并给出当前地址；不要一直刷新旧端口。
Restart only this service and use its current URL, not an old port.
expected: 浏览器打开当前地址，出现最小页面。
The current URL opens the minimal page.

title: Address already in use
Address already in use
check: 端口已被另一个进程使用，不代表代码语法错。
Another process occupies the port; this is not a syntax error.
action: 让 Codex 识别占用者；不确定就给本项目换空闲端口并同步 README，不结束无关进程。
Identify the owner; if uncertain choose a free project port and update README without terminating unrelated processes.
expected: 运行输出和浏览器使用同一个新端口。
Server output and browser use the same new port.

action: 让 Codex 只做第一项页面任务，点击回复里的实际 http 网址。此时能看见输入框和列表占位，不要求保存成功。
Ask Codex to implement only the first page task and open its actual HTTP URL. Inputs and a list placeholder are enough; saving is not ready yet.
expected: 浏览器地址以 http 开头；页面明确未接数据库，不显示假的保存成功。
The page uses HTTP and clearly says persistence is not connected.
recovery: 双击 index.html 打开的 file 地址不用于本全栈练习；回到服务给出的实际网址。
A double-clicked file URL is not this full-stack entry; use the running service URL.
instruction: 本次只实现计划中的页面任务，未连接的保存明确不可用，不用 localStorage 或假成功替代后端。返回真实 http 入口，后端任务留到 save 步骤。
Implement only the planned page task, make disconnected saving clearly unavailable and avoid localStorage or fake success. Return the real HTTP entry; leave backend tasks to save.

action: 对照原型核对标题、内容、按钮和提示是否看得懂；手机窄屏也能填写。
Compare title, body, button and messages with the prototype; try a narrow viewport.
expected: 输入框有名字；保存按钮和结果提示可见，文字不被截断。
Fields are labeled; Save and feedback are visible without clipped text.
recovery: 界面已符合设计就记录通过，不为了走步骤强行改颜色。
If the design is met, record the check rather than forcing cosmetic changes.
instruction: 只核对与修改本页的标签、布局和状态提示，保留已确认字段及接口约定；尚未接线不要声称保存可用。
Check or adjust labels, layout and status messages only, preserving fields and API agreement; do not claim working persistence before connection.

action: 先展开本步“逐项跟着做”，按数据库准备、后端检查、页面连接、重启读回的顺序操作。每完成一项，核对实际结果再向所选工具发送下一项。
Expand this step’s follow-along actions. Prepare storage, check the backend, connect the page and verify after restart. Review each result before sending the next task to your chosen tool.
expected: 输入“练习 A”保存后有真实记录编号；第二浏览器访问同一服务也能读到。
Saving “Practice A” produces a real record ID readable from a second browser on the same service.
recovery: 只有页面出现一行还不够；要求核对真实 SQLite 文件中的同一编号，禁止清库重建来修复。
A new row on screen is insufficient; verify the same ID in the actual SQLite file without clearing/recreating it.
instruction:
这是个人本机学习记录示例，先检查已有文件与实现，不重做已完成部分。请先用白话告诉我页面、后端和数据库各在哪里，然后一次只做下面一项，报告证据并等我核对后再继续：
1. 数据库：使用 SQLite，说明 instance/journal.sqlite 的实际完整路径，路径不能随启动目录改变。检查已有记录并说明备份方法；非破坏性准备 entries 表，包含 id（编号）、title（标题）、body（内容）、created_at（创建时间）。
2. 后端：提供 GET /api/entries 读取列表和 POST /api/entries 保存记录。后端检查去除首尾空白后的内容及约定长度，使用参数化 SQL，事务提交成功后才返回成功。用一条独特测试内容报告请求结果和编号，再只读核对数据库同一条记录；空白请求不能写入。
3. 页面：使用相对 /api/entries 连接同一服务，检查 HTTP 状态；提交中禁重复点击，失败保留输入并说明原因。告诉我准确启动方式、打开哪个网址、填写什么以及点哪里；不要只给代码。
4. 读回：指导我在第二浏览器打开同一网址，随后只重启本项目服务，再检查原记录。逐项记录实际结果与未测项，不替我宣布本人验收通过。
若请求结果不确定，先查询再决定是否重试，避免重复写入。不要删库、清表、关闭浏览器安全检查，也不要加入登录等未要求功能。

This is the personal local learning journal example. Inspect existing files and preserve finished work. Explain where the page, backend and database are. Perform only one item at a time, report evidence and wait for my review:
1. Database: use SQLite; resolve instance/journal.sqlite to a stable full path independent of startup directory. Inspect existing records and explain backup. Prepare entries non-destructively with id, title, body and created_at.
2. Backend: GET /api/entries reads the list; POST saves a record. Validate trimmed content and agreed length limits on the backend, use parameterized SQL and return success only after commit. Report a unique test item’s response and ID, then read the matching database record. Blank requests must not insert.
3. Page: use relative /api/entries on the same service, check HTTP status, prevent pending repeat clicks and retain input with an explanation on failure. Give exact startup, URL, input and click instructions, not only code.
4. Read back: guide me through a second browser on the same URL, then restart only this project service and check old records. Record actual and untested results without claiming my acceptance.
For uncertain outcomes, query before retrying to avoid duplicates. Do not delete storage, drop tables, disable browser security or add unrequested login features.

title: 保存显示 404，或返回一段 HTML
Save returns 404 or HTML
check: 核对 /api/entries 是否打到了正在运行的 Flask 服务。
Check whether /api/entries reaches the running Flask service.
action: 把实际网址、请求路径和后端日志交给 Codex 对照路由；本例页面和接口用同一服务，不另开静态文件。
Give Codex the actual URL, request path and service log to compare routes; this example serves page and API together.
expected: GET 返回列表，POST 合法内容返回记录编号。
GET returns a list; a valid POST returns a record ID.

title: 提示 CORS 或跨域
CORS / cross-origin error
check: 先核对页面是否从 file:// 或另一个端口打开。
Check whether the page came from file:// or another port.
action: 本例打开 Flask 提供的 http 地址，页面使用相对 /api/entries。不要关闭浏览器安全检查；不同服务的项目请按设计设置指定来源。
Use the Flask HTTP URL and relative /api/entries. Do not disable browser security; separate-service projects need approved origins in their design.
expected: 页面请求同一服务，不再出现跨域阻拦。
The same-service request is no longer blocked.

title: no such table: entries
no such table: entries
check: 数据库文件存在不代表里面已经建好表；先核对完整路径。
An existing database file may lack its table; check its full path first.
action: 让 Codex 在正确文件上执行已确认的非破坏性建表，不能删除数据库或复制会清空表的示例命令。
Run the agreed non-destructive setup on the correct file; do not delete the database or copy table-dropping examples.
expected: entries 表存在，原有记录未被清除。
entries exists and old data is retained.

title: database is locked
database is locked
check: 检查是否有另一测试服务、数据库编辑器或未结束的写入占着同一文件。
Check for another test service, editor or unfinished write holding the file.
action: 只结束确认属于本练习的占用，让 Codex 检查事务与连接是否及时关闭；不要删除锁文件或原数据库。
Stop only a confirmed practice owner and inspect transaction/connection cleanup; do not delete lock files or the database.
expected: 写入恢复，已保存记录仍可读取。
Writing recovers while old records remain readable.

title: 保存提示成功，刷新后记录不见了
Success appears, but refresh loses the record
check: 记下唯一测试标题、页面网址和记录编号；请工具核对是否只更新了页面或浏览器缓存。
Record a unique title, URL and ID; check whether only the page or browser cache was updated.
action: 请工具只读对照保存请求结果、数据库中的同一编号和读取列表结果，先找出在哪一步丢失。页面须等后端实际保存成功才显示成功，不用固定成功提示掩盖问题。
Read-only compare save response, database record and list response to locate the loss. Show success only after real backend persistence.
expected: 真实数据库、读取接口和刷新后的页面显示同一条测试记录。
Database, read endpoint and refreshed page show the same test record.

title: 打不开网址，提示连接被拒绝
The URL refuses the connection
check: 核对地址是否与本项目启动输出一致，以及服务是否仍在运行。端口就是网址中冒号后的服务编号。
Compare the URL with this project’s startup output and check that the service is running. A port is the service number after the colon.
action: 把网址和最近的启动错误交给工具，让它检查本项目进程。未启动就按该项目说明启动；端口被占用时先查归属，再选择空闲端口并更新打开地址，不结束不认识的进程。

Give the URL and recent startup error to the tool. Start this project as documented; for an occupied port identify its owner, choose a free port and update the URL rather than stopping unknown processes.
expected: 服务持续运行，使用实际启动地址能打开页面；然后再检查保存功能。
The service remains running and its actual URL opens the page; then check saving.

title: 保存失败，但列表里已经出现记录
Save reports failure, but the record exists
check: 服务器可能已保存，只是返回结果途中断开；先按唯一测试标题查看列表和数据库。
The server may have saved before the response was lost; search the unique title in the list and database.
action: 暂不再次提交。把已存在的编号与失败提示交给工具，核对响应处理与重复提交保护；同一次操作是否重复要按编号和内容检查，不能直接删除所有相同标题。
Do not submit again yet. Give the existing ID and error to the tool; inspect response handling and repeat-submission protection. Compare IDs and content rather than deleting matching titles.
expected: 确认该次提交是否已保存，界面给出准确反馈；旧记录保留。
The submission outcome is established, feedback is accurate and old records remain.

action: 从页面输入“练习 B”，点一次保存，看成功提示与列表，再刷新和换浏览器读同一编号。
Enter “Practice B”, save once, inspect status/list, then refresh and read the same ID in another browser.
expected: 页面、接口和数据库三处的记录编号及内容一致。
Page, API and database agree on ID and content.
recovery: 某层查不到先记录断在哪：按钮、请求、写入还是读取；交给反馈步骤，不在测试里顺手改代码。
Record the failing layer: button, request, write or read. Send it to feedback without changing code during testing.
instruction: 只核对一条唯一测试记录的页面→POST→数据库→GET→页面链路，记录编号及各层实际证据。无法观测的层写未验证，不以推测代替。
Verify one unique record through page→POST→database→GET→page. Record its ID and actual evidence for each layer; mark unobservable layers unverified.

action: 分别试空白、全空格、超长、连续点击；再由 Codex 停止本练习服务后试保存，确认原文还在。
Try blank, spaces, oversized text and double clicking; then stop only this practice service and try saving, keeping the input.
expected: 无效内容不入库；服务停了不能提示成功；连点同一次提交只新增一条。
Invalid data is not stored; a stopped service cannot report success; double clicking one submission creates one record.
recovery: 自动检查通过但画面不对仍记失败；不要关闭所有 Python 进程，只停止本项目进程。
Record visible failure even if automated checks pass; stop only this project’s process, not every Python process.
instruction: 仅测试：绕过页面直接向后端发送空白/超长输入应拒绝且条数不变；检查双击提交、网络失败保留输入、列表读取失败有提示。保留原检查结果，本步不修复。 请求结果不确定时先读列表确认是否已保存，再重试，不能假定网络报错就一定没写入。

Test only: direct backend blank/oversized requests must fail without new records; check double submit, preserved input on network failure and visible list-load errors. Retain results, do not repair here. If the response is uncertain, read the list before retrying; a network error does not prove no write occurred.

action: 记下练习记录编号，按 README 停止服务，再从原文件夹重启并打开网址。
Note a record ID, stop as documented, restart from the original folder and open the URL.
expected: 同一编号仍可读取；重启没有重新创建空库。
The same ID remains readable; restart did not create an empty database.
recovery: 记录消失先核对数据库绝对路径是否变了，保留原文件；不要重新初始化清空。
If missing, compare absolute database paths and preserve the original file; do not reset it.
instruction: 实际停止并重启本项目服务，核对 instance/journal.sqlite 绝对路径、原记录编号与数量。使用后端查询证明保留，记录准确命令及端口；不得重置数据库。
Stop/restart only this service, compare the absolute database path and original record ID/count, and prove retention with a backend query. Record real commands/port; never reset the database.

title: 重启后列表突然为空
List becomes empty after restart
check: 让 Codex 对比重启前后的数据库绝对路径和数量，先别新增记录。
Compare database absolute paths and counts before adding more data.
action: 如果打开了另一份空库，保留两份文件并修正固定路径；只读确认旧记录，再启动。
If a different empty database was opened, preserve both files and correct the fixed path; inspect old records before starting.
expected: 原来的编号和内容重新出现。
Original IDs and content return.

action: 按原需求亲手做一轮新记录、重新读取、失败后重试和重启检查，再填写自己的实际结果。
Personally test creation, retrieval, retry and restart against original requirements before filling results.
expected: 验收记录对应当前版本，明确前端、后端、数据库各有什么证据。
Acceptance names the current version and evidence for page, backend and database.
recovery: 没做的写未测试；示例成功记录不能复制成自己的通过结论。
Mark unperformed checks untested; do not copy example success as your own result.
instruction: 本人实际试用：版本、入口、记录编号、正常保存、空白拒绝、服务停止后输入保留、重新启动读回。逐项填通过/失败/未测试及实际现象。
Personal trial: version, entry, record ID, normal save, blank rejection, preserved input while stopped and restart read-back. Fill passed/failed/untested with actual observations.

action: 把失败时输入的测试内容、点击顺序、时间、页面提示和报错放在一起；截图不要含私人资料。
Collect test input, click sequence, time, page message and error together; omit private data from screenshots.
expected: 别人能照记录复现，不只有“保存坏了”。
Someone can reproduce the issue, rather than merely reading “save broke”.
recovery: 不知道什么是日志时，让 Codex 指出本项目服务输出的位置并只提取对应时间的错误。
If logs are unfamiliar, ask Codex to locate this service’s output and extract the matching error.
instruction: 注明故障在哪个小检查：建表/接口/页面接线/读回/重启。区分页面提示和后端报错；不粘贴数据库完整内容或密钥。
Name the failing check: table/API/connection/read/restart. Distinguish page messages from backend errors; do not paste full database contents or secrets.

action: 让 Codex 先复现，再说明只改哪一层，改完重跑哪条失败操作。
Ask Codex to reproduce and identify the layer to change and the failed action to rerun.
expected: 修复计划包括数据保护及原本正常保存的回归检查。
The plan protects data and retests previously working saves.
recovery: 建议删库时先停止，要求备份和非破坏性方案；缺证据就先补诊断。
Stop a suggested database deletion; request backup and a non-destructive plan or more diagnosis.
instruction: 请先只读排查本次反馈编号，不改代码。根据我填写的实际网址、输入、点击、预期、实际结果和错误原文，先列已有事实与缺失证据。依次检查：页面有没有发出请求；是否到达正确后端；后端返回什么状态与错误；数据库实际路径和对应记录是什么。你能读取的日志请自己核对；需要我操作时给出具体入口和要复制的相关几行，并提醒移除密钥。不要让我猜技术原因。最后提出最小修复计划：问题编号、原因证据、修改文件、数据影响、备份与恢复办法、原失败步骤怎样复测、哪些正常功能需再检查。证据不足先提出一项最小检查，未经我确认不修复、不清库、不重装。

Diagnose this issue read-only. From my URL, input, clicks, expected/actual results and error text, separate facts from missing evidence. Check whether the page sent a request, whether it reached the right backend, the response status/error, and the actual database path and matching record. Inspect logs you can access; for manual collection give exact entry and relevant lines, removing secrets. Do not make me guess the technical cause. Propose the smallest plan with issue ID, cause evidence, files, data impact, backup/recovery, original-case retest and working behavior to recheck. With insufficient evidence request one minimal check. Do not fix, reset or reinstall before my confirmation.

action: 执行确认过的一项修复，自己重做原失败操作，再确认旧记录还在。
Apply one agreed fix, repeat the original failing action personally and check old records remain.
expected: 原问题通过，正常新增/读取及已有数据也通过。
The failure, normal create/read and existing data all pass.
recovery: 测试状态被 AI 全改成通过时，恢复真实未测项；要求区分它的测试与本人试用。
If everything was marked passed, restore untested statuses and separate AI checks from personal trials.
instruction: 修复只针对已确认问题；数据库变更先在副本验证并保留恢复方法。记录修复前后同一失败用例和旧记录读取，不代替本人验收。
Fix only agreed issues; test database changes on a copy first with recovery instructions. Record the same failing case before/after plus old-record reads, without claiming user acceptance.

action: 本轮先选本机自用：一个启动方法、一个网页入口、一份数据库。公开给别人用是之后的单独决定。
Choose local delivery first: one startup method, web entry and database. Public use is a later decision.
expected: 知道 localhost 只指向打开它的那台电脑；完整全栈项目可先本机交付。
You know localhost refers to the current computer; a full-stack project can be delivered locally.
recovery: 把本机网址发给朋友打不开不等于代码坏了，不用关闭防火墙解决。
A friend cannot use your localhost URL; that does not prove broken code and is not fixed by disabling a firewall.
instruction: 记录本轮为本机单人交付；前端、后端、SQLite 都在本机。若以后公开，另定登录、数据隔离、持久磁盘、HTTPS 和费用，不在本步自动部署。
Record local single-user delivery with all three layers local. Future public use needs identity, isolation, persistent disk, HTTPS and costs; do not auto-deploy here.

action: 核对当前版本确实通过保存、读回、异常和重启；确认启动说明没有只写“打开 HTML”。
Confirm save, read, failures and restart for this version; startup must not merely say open HTML.
expected: 清单涵盖依赖、启动、数据库位置、备份和未验证事项。
Checklist includes dependencies, startup, database location, backup and unverified items.
recovery: 没有实际验收文件就返回验收，不能让 Codex 自动补成通过。
Return to acceptance if its file is missing; do not auto-generate a pass.
instruction: 按本机全栈交付核对虚拟环境、锁定依赖、数据库初始化不清旧数据、固定路径和恢复方案；GitHub Pages 不能单独托管本练习的后端。
Assess local full-stack delivery: environment, pinned dependencies, non-destructive setup, fixed database path and recovery. GitHub Pages alone cannot host this backend.

action: 让 Codex 准备启动说明和依赖文件，在独立测试副本试运行；数据库用测试数据，不复制私人记录。
Prepare startup instructions/dependencies and trial an isolated copy with test data rather than private records.
expected: 从干净副本可以启动前后端、保存并读回一条记录。
A clean copy starts and saves/reads one record.
recovery: 不能把当前电脑的 .venv 整个复制当通用安装包；应按依赖记录重新建立环境。
Do not treat a copied .venv as a portable package; recreate the environment from dependencies.
instruction: 仅准备本机交付：README 写明项目目录、按系统创建 .venv、安装依赖、非破坏性建库、启动/停止、真实入口、备份恢复。用独立测试副本验证，记录未测系统，不公开。

Prepare local delivery only: directory, OS-specific environment/dependencies, non-destructive database setup, start/stop, actual URL and backup/restore. Test an isolated copy, name untested systems and do not publish.

action: 从交付说明的入口亲手打开，新增“交付核对”并重启读回，不使用旧页面缓存当证据。
Open the delivered entry, create “Delivery check” and read it after restart rather than relying on a cached page.
expected: 实际交付版本可用，数据库路径和使用范围写清楚。
The delivered revision works with a documented database path and usage scope.
recovery: 无法打开先按说明检查服务，失败保留待交付，不把文件准备好当交付成功。
Check the service if opening fails; retain pending status instead of equating prepared files with successful delivery.
instruction: 只执行本人允许的本机交付，核对前端请求实际到达该后端和数据库；记录实际版本/入口/编号。没有公网授权就不开放服务。
Perform only authorized local delivery; verify requests reach its backend/database and record revision/entry/ID. Do not expose publicly without authorization.

action: 这个动作是静态网站的可选参考。本全栈练习直接继续维护，不把 Python 和数据库上传 Pages。
This optional action is for static sites. Continue to maintenance for this full-stack practice; do not upload Python/database to Pages.
expected: 明确 Pages 不能运行本练习后端，数据库不公开。
Pages cannot run this backend and the database stays private.
recovery: 若有人只发布页面，保存会失败；回到交付方案选择能运行后端并保留数据的方案。
Publishing just the page breaks saves; choose a delivery plan that runs the backend and retains data.
instruction: 只判断适用性：本项目依赖 Flask 和 SQLite，不能用纯 Pages 完整交付。说明原因并返回交付方式，不发布。
Assess suitability only: Flask/SQLite cannot be fully delivered by static Pages. Explain and return to delivery planning without publishing.

action: 按 README 备份数据库，在独立临时目录恢复并核对同一记录；下次先读交接文件再继续。
Back up the database as documented, restore to an isolated directory, verify the record and read the handoff next time.
expected: 备份文件实际能恢复，原数据库未被覆盖。
The backup restores successfully without overwriting the original.
recovery: 复制正在写入的数据库可能不完整；使用 SQLite 备份接口，或确认服务停止后按已核验方法复制。
Copying an actively written database may be incomplete; use SQLite backup or a verified stopped-service copy.
instruction: 在获准的独立测试目录用 SQLite backup 接口备份/恢复，验证记录编号和条数；绝不覆盖原库。交接写明命令、数据库绝对路径、依赖版本和下一任务，未演练就标未验证。

Use SQLite backup/restore in an authorized isolated test directory, verify IDs/counts and never overwrite the original. Handoff records commands, absolute database path, dependencies and next task; unperformed restore remains unverified.
